t.E969.agn: In 2013 EFSA set the acceptable daily intake (ADI) at 5 mg/kg body weight and reported that estimated intake remained below this limit even in high-consuming adults and children.
t.E969.body: It is absorbed quickly but in small amounts and is excreted mainly in the faeces.
t.E969.prod: A sweetener produced by chemical synthesis.
t.E969.regx.1: Added to the EU list as a sweetener (Regulation (EU) 497/2014).
t.E969.summary: A synthetic sweetener derived from aspartame, thousands of times sweeter than sugar. Used in very small amounts.
t.E969.what: An intense sweetener thousands of times sweeter than sugar, used in very small amounts.
